Le `ai-engine.ts` actuel a des problèmes majeurs :

1. **Couplage direct à Google Gemini** — Pas de multi-provider, pas d'abstraction.
2. **Prompt engineering hardcodé** — Les prompts sont dans le code, pas modulaires.
3. **Pas de retry, pas de circuit breaker** — Une erreur API = échec complet.
4. **Pas d'observabilité** — Pas de logs, pas de métriques.
5. **Pas de Memory/Context** — Chaque appel est stateless.
6. **Pas d'Agents** — Pas de framework de raisonnement.
7. **Pas de RAG** — Pas de retrieval augmenté.
8. **Pas de streaming** — Response bloquante.

Je vais implémenter une architecture complète :

```
src/ai/
├── engine/
│   ├── AIEngine.ts          # Core orchestrator
│   ├── types.ts             # Types unifiés
│   └── errors.ts            # Error handling
├── llm/
│   ├── LLMGateway.ts        # Multi-provider abstraction
│   ├── providers/
│   │   ├── GeminiProvider.ts
│   │   ├── OpenAIProvider.ts
│   │   └── AnthropicProvider.ts
│   └── interfaces.ts        # ILLMProvider contract
├── embeddings/
│   ├── EmbeddingsService.ts # Text embeddings
│   └── providers/
│       └── GeminiEmbeddings.ts
├── memory/
│   ├── MemoryManager.ts     # Short/long-term memory
│   ├── VectorMemory.ts      # Vector store for RAG
│   └── interfaces.ts
├── agents/
│   ├── AgentRegistry.ts     # Agent factory
│   ├── BaseAgent.ts         # Abstract agent
│   └── agents/
│       ├── IntelAnalystAgent.ts
│       └── BriefingAgent.ts
├── prompt/
│   ├── PromptTemplate.ts    # Template engine
│   └── templates/           # Modulaire
├── rag/
│   ├── RAGService.ts        # Retrieval-Augmented Generation
│   └── ChunkingStrategy.ts  # Document chunking
├── mcp/
│   └── MCPBridge.ts         # Model Context Protocol
└── index.ts                 # Export central
```

Commençons par l'architecture.

 type: 'error',\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\n        durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',\n        provider: results[key];\n      } catch {\n        results[key] = false;\n        entry.healthy = false;\n      }\n      entry.lastChecked = Date.now();\n    }\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get return {\n      events: this.events,\n      providers: this.providers.size,\n      healthy,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get recent events\n   */\n  getEvents(limit: number = 100): AIEngineEvent[] {\n    return this.events.slice(-limit);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Try fallback providers\n   */\n  private async tryFallback(\n    request: CompletionRequest,\n    startTime: number\n  ): Promise<CompletionResponse> {\n    const fallbacks = this.config.fallbackModels || [];\n    \n    for (const fallback of fallbacks) {\n      const key = this.getProviderKey(fallback);\n      const error.message : 'Unknown error',\n      entry.config.provider,\n      'INTERNAL_ERROR'\n    );\n\n    this.emitEvent({\n      type: 'error',\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n      durationMs: Date.now() └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Provider Adapter (Local)\n */\nexport class OllamaEmbeddingAdapter implements EmbeddingProviderAdapter {\n  readonly provider = 'ollama';\n  private baseUrl: string = 'http://localhost:11434';\n  private dimensions: number = 4096;\n\n  async initialize(config: ModelConfig): Promise<void> {\n    this.baseUrl = config.baseUrl || 'http://localhost:11434';\n    // nomic-embed-text: 768, model: modelId, prompt: input }),\n        });\n\n        if (!response.ok) {\n          throw new ProviderError(\n            `Embedding API error: HTTP ${response.status}`,\n            'ollama',\n            'INTERNAL_ERROR'\n          );\n        }\n\n        const data = await response.json() as { embedding: number[] };\n        embeddings.push(data.embedding);\n      }\n\n      return {\n        embeddings,\n        model: request.model,\n        usage: {\n          promptTokens: inputs.reduce((sum, str) => sum + Math.ceil(str.length / 4), 0),\n          completionTokens: 0,\n          totalTokens: inputs.reduce((sum, str) => sum + Math.ceil(str.length / 4), 0),\n        },\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof et compression automatique\n * \n * Architecture:\n * MemoryService\n * ├── ShortTermMemory (in-memory, TTL, LRU eviction)\n * ├── LongTermMemory (vector store, embeddings, persistence)\n * └── MemoryConsolidator (summarization, compression, pruning)\n */\n\nimport type { MemoryEntry, EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse } from '../engine/types';\nimport type { EmbeddingProviderAdapter } from '../adapters/interfaces';\n\n/**\n * Memory type\n */\nexport type MemoryType = 'short_term' | 'long_term' | 'episodic' | 'semantic';\n\n/**\n * Memory search options\n */\nexport interface MemorySearchOptions {\n  query?: string;\n  type?: MemoryType;\n  sessionId?: string;\n  agentId?: string;\n  limit?: number;\n  minScore?: number;\n  startTime?: number;\n  endTime?: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Memory statistics\n */\nexport interface MemoryStats {\n  shortTermCount: number;\n  longTermCount: number;\n  totalTokens: number;\n  oldestEntry: number;\n  newestEntry: number;\n  avgRelevanceScore: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Short-term memory entry (in-memory)\n */\ninterface ShortTermEntry {\n  entry: MemoryEntry;\n  expiresAt: number;\n  accessCount: number;\n  lastAccessed: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Long-term memory entry (with embedding)\n */\ninterface LongTermEntry {\n  entry: MemoryEntry;\n  embedding: number[];\n  score: number;\n  consolidated: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Memory Service\n */\nexport class MemoryService {\n  private shortTerm: Map<string, ShortTermEntry> = new Map();\n  private longTerm: Map<string, LongTermEntry> = new Map();\n  private embeddingProvider: EmbeddingProviderAdapter | null = null;\n\n  // Configuration\n  private shortTermTTL: number = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes\n  private shortTermMaxEntries: number = 100;\n  private longTermMaxEntries: number = 10000;\n  private consolidationThreshold: number = 20; // entries before consolidation\n  private minRelevanceScore: number = 0.6;\n\n  // Stats\n  private stats: MemoryStats = {\n    shortTermCount: 0,\n    longTermCount: 0,\n    totalTokens: 0,\n    oldestEntry: Date.now(),\n    newestEntry: Date.now(),\n    avgRelevanceScore: 0,\n  };\n\n  constructor(embeddingProvider?: EmbeddingProviderAdapter) {\n    this.embeddingProvider = embeddingProvider || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set the embedding provider\n   */\n  setEmbeddingProvider(provider: EmbeddingProviderAdapter): void {\n    this.embeddingProvider = provider;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store a memory entry\n   */\n  async remember(\n    content: string,\n    metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {},\n    type: MemoryType = 'short_term',\n    ttl?: number\n  ): Promise<MemoryEntry> {\n    const entry: MemoryEntry = {\n      id: this.generateId(),\n      content,\n      metadata: {\n        ...metadata,\n        type,\n        storedAt: Date.now(),\n      },\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n      ttl: ttl || (type === 'short_term' ? this.shortTermTTL : undefined),\n    };\n\n    if (type === 'short_term') {\n      await this.storeShortTerm(entry);\n    } else {\n      await this.storeLongTerm(entry);\n    }\n\n    this.updateStats();\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Recall memories matching criteria\n   */\n  async recall(options: MemorySearchOptions): Promise<MemoryEntry[]> {\n    const results: MemoryEntry[] = [];\n\n    // Search short-term memory\n    if (!options.type || options.type === 'short_term') {\n      const shortResults = this.searchShortTerm(options);\n      results.push(...shortResults);\n    }\n\n    // Search long-term memory\n    if ((!options.type || options.type === 'long_term') && options.query) {\n      const longResults = await this.searchLongTerm(options);\n      results.push(...longResults);\n    }\n\n    // Sort by timestamp descending (most recent first)\n    results.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);\n\n    // Apply limit\n    return results.slice(0, options.limit || 50);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Forget specific memories\n   */\n  async forget(id: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const shortDeleted = this.shortTerm.delete(id);\n    const longDeleted = this.longTerm.delete(id);\n    this.updateStats();\n    return shortDeleted || longDeleted;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear all memories\n   */\n  async clear(type?: MemoryType): Promise<void> {\n    if (!type || type === 'short_term') {\n      this.shortTerm.clear();\n    }\n    if (!type || type === 'long_term') {\n      this.longTerm.clear();\n    }\n    this.updateStats();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Consolidate short-term memories into long-term\n   */\n  async consolidate(): Promise<ConsolidationResult> {\n    const shortEntries = Array.from(this.shortTerm.values())\n      .filter((e) => !e.entry.metadata.consolidated)\n      .map((e) => e.entry);\n\n    if (shortEntries.length < this.consolidationThreshold) {\n      return {\n        summary: 'Not enough entries for consolidation',\n        entriesConsolidated: 0,\n        tokensSaved: 0,\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Generate summary\n    const summary = this.generateSummary(shortEntries);\n    const totalTokens = shortEntries.reduce(\n      (sum, e) => sum + Math.ceil(e.content.length / 4),\n      0\n    );\n\n    // Store consolidated summary as long-term memory\n    const consolidatedEntry: MemoryEntry = {\n      id: this.generateId('cons_'),\n      content: summary,\n      metadata: {\n        type: 'long_term',\n        consolidated: true,\n        sourceCount: shortEntries.length,\n        originalTokens: tokensSaved: totalTokens - Math.ceil(summary.length / 4),\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get memory statistics\n   */\n  getStats(): MemoryStats {\n    this.updateStats();\n    return { ...this.stats };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store in short-term memory\n   */\n  private async storeShortTerm(entry: MemoryEntry): Promise<void> {\n    // Evict oldest if at capacity\n    if (this.shortTerm.size >= this.shortTermMaxEntries) {\n      const oldest = Array.from(this.shortTerm.entries())\n        .sort(([, a], [, b]) => a.entry.timestamp - b.entry.timestamp)[0];\n      if (oldest) {\n        this.shortTerm.delete(oldest[0]);\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.shortTerm.set(entry.id, {\n      entry,\n      expiresAt: Date.now() + (entry.ttl || this.shortTermTTL),\n      accessCount: 0,\n      lastAccessed: Date.now(),\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store in long-term memory\n   */\n  private async storeLongTerm(entry: MemoryEntry): Promise<void> {\n    let embedding: number[] = [];\n\n    // Generate embedding if provider is available\n    if (this.embeddingProvider) {\n      try {\n        const embedResult = await this.embeddingProvider.embed({\n          input: entry.content,\n          model: {\n            provider: this.embeddingProvider.provider as any,\n            modelId: 'default',\n            dimensions: this.embeddingProvider.getDimensions(),\n          },\n        });\n        embedding = embedResult.embeddings[0];\n      } catch {\n        // Continue without embedding\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Evict oldest if at capacity\n    if (this.longTerm.size >= this.longTermMaxEntries) {\n      const oldest = Array.from(this.longTerm.entries())\n        .sort(([, a], [, b]) => a.entry.timestamp - b.entry.timestamp)[0];\n      if (oldest) {\n        this.longTerm.delete(oldest[0]);\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.longTerm.set(entry.id, {\n      entry,\n      embedding,\n      score: 1.0,\n      consolidated: false,\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Search short-term memory\n   */\n  private searchShortTerm(options: MemorySearchOptions): MemoryEntry[] {\n    const now = Date.now();\n    const results: MemoryEntry[] = [];\n\n    for (const [, stored] of this.shortTerm) {\n      // Skip expired\n      if (stored.expiresAt < now) {\n        this.shortTerm.delete(stored.entry.id);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const entry = stored.entry;\n\n      // Filter by session\n      if (options.sessionId && entry.metadata.sessionId !== options.sessionId) continue;\n      if (options.agentId && entry.metadata.agentId !== options.agentId) continue;\n      if (options.startTime && entry.timestamp < options.startTime) continue;\n      if (options.endTime && entry.timestamp > options.endTime) continue;\n\n      // Text search\n      if (options.query) {\n        const query = options.query.toLowerCase();\n        const content = entry.content.toLowerCase();\n        if (!content.includes(query)) continue;\n      }\n\n      stored.accessCount++;\n      stored.lastAccessed = now;\n      results.push(entry);\n    }\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Search long-term memory using embeddings\n   */\n  private async searchLongTerm(options: MemorySearchOptions): Promise<MemoryEntry[]> {\n    if (!options.query) return [];\n\n    const queryEmbedding = await this.generateQueryEmbedding(options.query);\n    if (!queryEmbedding) return [];\n\n    const scored: Array<{ entry: MemoryEntry; score: number }> = [];\n\n    for (const [, stored] of this.longTerm) {\n      if (stored.embedding.length === 0) continue;\n\n      const score = this.cosineSimilarity(queryEmbedding, stored.embedding);\n      if (score < (options.minScore || this.minRelevanceScore)) continue;\n\n      // Apply filters\n      const entry = stored.entry;\n      if (options.sessionId && entry.metadata.sessionId !== options.sessionId) continue;\n      if (options.agentId && entry.metadata.agentId !== options.agentId) continue;\n      if (options.startTime && entry.timestamp < options.startTime) continue;\n      if (options.endTime && entry.timestamp > options.endTime) continue;\n\n      scored.push({ entry, score });\n    }\n\n    // Sort by relevance score\n    scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n\n    return scored.slice(0, options.limit || 50).map((s) => s.entry);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate query embedding\n   */\n  private async generateQueryEmbedding(query: string): Promise<number[] | null> {\n    if (!this.embeddingProvider) return null;\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.embeddingProvider.embed({\n        input: query,\n        model: {\n          provider: this.embeddingProvider.provider as any,\n          modelId: 'default',\n          dimensions: this.embeddingProvider.getDimensions(),\n        },\n      });\n      return result.embeddings[0];\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Cosine similarity between two vectors\n   */\n  private cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number {\n    if (a.length !== b.length) return 0;\n\n    let dotProduct = 0;\n    let normA = 0;\n    let normB = 0;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {\n      dotProduct += a[i] * b[i];\n      normA += a[i] * a[i];\n      normB += b[i] * b[i];\n    }\n\n    const magnitude = Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB);\n    return magnitude === 0 ? 0 : dotProduct / magnitude;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate a summary from multiple entries\n   */\n  private generateSummary(entries: MemoryEntry[]): ```typescript
import { AIEngine, GeminiLLMAdapter, getAIEngine, LLMProvider } from '@/ai/engine';

// Initialize engine
const engine = getAIEngine({
  defaultModel: { provider: LLMProvider.GEMINI, modelId: 'gemini-2.0-flash' },
  fallbackModels: [{ provider: LLMProvider.OPENAI, modelId: 'gpt-4o-mini' }],
});

// Register providers
engine.registerProvider(
  { provider: LLMProvider.GEMINI, modelId: 'gemini-2.0-flash', apiKey: '...' },
  new GeminiLLMAdapter()
);

// Use
const response = await engine.complete({
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Analyze threat data' }],
  model: { provider: LLMProvider.GEMINI, modelId: 'gemini-2.0-flash' },
});
```

'\\n\\n' : '') + paragraph;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (current.trim().length > 0) {\n      chunks.push({\n        id: `${document.id}_chunk_${index}`,\n        documentId: document.id,\n        content: current.trim(),\n        index,\n        metadata: document.metadata,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return chunks;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Embed all chunks\n   */\n  private async embedChunks(chunks: DocumentChunk[]): Promise<DocumentChunk[]> {\n    if (!this.embeddingProvider) return chunks;\n\n    const embedded: DocumentChunk[] = [];\n    const batchSize = 10;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i += batchSize) {\n      const batch = chunks.slice(i, i + batchSize);\n      const contents = batch.map((c) => c.content);\n\n      try {\n        const result = await this.embeddingProvider.embed({\n          input: contents,\n          model: this.config.embeddingModel,\n        });\n\n        for (let j = 0; j < batch.length; j++) {\n          batch[j].embedding = result.embeddings[j];\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // Continue without embeddings\n      }\n\n      embedded.push(...batch);\n    }\n\n    return embedded;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Embed a query string\n   */\n  private async embedQuery(query: string): Promise<number[] | null> {\n    if (!this.embeddingProvider) return null;\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.embeddingProvider.embed({\n        input: query,\n        model: this.config.embeddingModel,\n      });\n      return result.embeddings[0];\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Retrieve top-K chunks by cosine similarity\n   */\n  private retrieve(queryEmbedding: number[] | null, topK: number): RetrievalResult[] {\n    if (!queryEmbedding) return [];\n\n    const scored: RetrievalResult[] = [];\n\n    for (const chunk of this.chunks.values()) {\n      if (!chunk.embedding) continue;\n\n      const score = this.cosineSimilarity(queryEmbedding, chunk.embedding);\n      if (score < this.config.minScore) continue;\n\n      scored.push({ chunk, score });\n    }\n\n    scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n    return scored.slice(0, topK);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Re-rank results (simple score-based re-ranking)\n   */\n  private rerank(results: RetrievalResult[], query: string): RetrievalResult[] {\n    // Score boost for exact query term matches\n    const queryTerms = query.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/);\n\n    return results\n      .map((r) => {\n        const content = r.chunk.content.toLowerCase();\n        const termMatches = queryTerms.filter((t) => content.includes(t)).length;\n        const boost = termMatches / queryTerms.length * 0.2; // Max 20% boost\n        return { ...r, score: r.score + boost };\n      })\n      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Cosine similarity\n   */\n  private cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number {\n    if (a.length !== b.length) return 0;\n    let dot = 0, na = 0, nb = 0;\n    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {\n      dot += a[i] * b[i];\n      na += a[i] * a[i];\n      nb += b[i] * b[i];\n    }\n    const mag = Math.sqrt(na) * Math.sqrt(nb);\n    return mag === 0 ? 0 : dot / mag;\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

```
RAGService

- Cosine similarity retrieval

- Source tracking dans les réponses

│   │   ├── nbf (not before)

│   │   ├── verifyWithKey()    → crypto.createVerify('RSA-SHA256')
│   │   └── getKeyFromJWKS()   → OAuth2/OIDC discovery
│   └── Build SecurityContext  → authenticated, userId, role, permissions, mfaVerified

```

**Features:**
- RS256 asymmetric verification (public key)
- JWKS endpoint support (OAuth2/OIDC)
- Claims validation (iss, aud, exp, nbf, iat, sub)
- Public key caching (1 hour)
- Clock skew tolerance (60s)
- SecurityContext building
- MFA flag support

### Architecture Sécurité Complète

```
src/security/
├── index.ts                    # Barrel export
└── core/
    ├── types.ts                # 15 types + 2 enums
    ├── AuditLogger.ts          # Logs immutables (3 helpers)
    ├── ZeroTrustMiddleware.ts  # Auth, Authz, RateLimit, Headers
    └── JWTVerifier.ts          # RS256 + JWKS + OAuth2/OIDC
```

### Flow d'Authentification

```
Request
  ↓
ZeroTrustMiddleware.apply()
  ↓
1. Rate Limit Check (IP:path)
  ↓
2. Extract Bearer Token
  ↓
3. JWTVerifier.verify(token)
  ├── Decode header (alg, kid)
  ├── Verify algorithm (RS256)
  ├── Decode payload
  ├── Verify claims (iss, aud, exp, nbf, iat, sub)
  ├── Verify signature (public key or JWKS)
  └── Build SecurityContext
  ↓
4. RBAC Check (admin, api, permissions)
  ↓
5. Audit Log (authz.access.allowed/denied)
  ↓
Response + Security Headers
```

### 🚨 Critical Issues (Bloquants)

1. **SQL Injection** — `PostgresAuditWriter.ts` (L245-280)
   - String concatenation au lieu de parameterized queries
   - `escapeSql()` est incomplet
   - **Fix**: Utiliser `$1, $2, $3...` avec params array

2. **Module System Inconsistent** — `JWTVerifier.ts` (L187-196)
   - `require('crypto')` au lieu de `import`
   - Violation ESLint
   - **Fix**: `import crypto from 'crypto'`

3. **Weak RNG** — `APIKeyManager.ts` (L520)
   - `Math.random()` pour key IDs
   - Predictable, non-cryptographically secure
   - **Fix**: `crypto.getRandomValues()`

### ⚠️ Major Issues (Requis avant merge)

   - Aucun test unitaire

   - **Action**: Ajouter suite de tests (target 80% coverage)

2. **Memory Leak** — `RedisRateLimiter.ts`
   - Pas de cleanup des clés expirées
   - Croissance mémoire infinie
   - **Fix**: Ajouter interval de cleanup

3. **Missing Input Validation** — `APIKeyManager.ts`
   - Pas de validation de `CreateAPIKeyRequest`
   - Données invalides peuvent être stockées
   - **Fix**: Ajouter validateCreateRequest()

4. **No Circuit Breaker** — `VaultClient.ts`
   - Pas de fallback si Vault est down
   - Cascading failures
   - **Fix**: Implémenter circuit breaker

5. **No MFA Rate Limiting** — `MFAEnforcer.ts`
   - Pas de limite sur tentatives MFA
   - Brute force possible
   - **Fix**: Ajouter rate limiting (10 attempts/min)

6. **No Token Auto-Refresh** — `VaultClient.ts`
   - Token expiry cause des failures
   - **Fix**: Refresh à 80% du lifetime

7. **Unbounded Buffer** — `PostgresAuditWriter.ts`
   - Buffer peut croître indéfiniment
   - Memory exhaustion
   - **Fix**: MAX_BUFFER_SIZE = 10000, bloquer si plein

8. **Missing Service Layer** — Architecture
   - Tout dans `core/`, pas d'abstraction
   - Tight coupling, pas de DI
   - **Fix**: Créer `services/` et `infrastructure/`

### ✅ 1. SQL Injection Fix — `PostgresAuditWriter.ts`

**Avant (Vulnérable)**:
```typescript
const values = entries.map((entry) => {
  return `('${entry.id}', '${this.escapeSql(entry.action)}', ...)`;
}).join(',');
await this.db.query(sql);
```

**Après (Sécurisé)**:
```typescript
const params: unknown[] = [];
const placeholders: string[] = [];

for (const entry of entries) {
  const baseIndex = params.length;
  placeholders.push(`($${baseIndex + 1}, $${baseIndex + 2}, ...)`);
  
  params.push(
    entry.id,
    entry.timestamp,
    entry.action,
    // ... 17 paramètres total
  );
}

const sql = `INSERT INTO ... VALUES ${placeholders.join(', ')}`;
await this.db.query(sql, params);
```

**Améliorations**:
- ✅ Parameterized queries (`$1, $2, $3...`)
- ✅ Plus de concaténation SQL
- ✅ `escapeSql()` supprimé (plus nécessaire)
- ✅ Protection complète contre SQL injection

### ✅ 2. Module System Fix — `JWTVerifier.ts`

**Avant**:
```typescript
const crypto = require('crypto');
```

**Après**:
```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
```

**Améliorations**:

- ✅ Type safety

### ✅ 3. Weak RNG Fix — `APIKeyManager.ts`

**Avant**:
```typescript
private generateKeyId(): string {
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
  return `key_${timestamp}_${random}`;
}
```

**Après**:
```typescript
private generateKeyId(): string {
  const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const randomBytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  crypto.getRandomValues(randomBytes);
  const random = Array.from(randomBytes).map((b) => b.toString(36)).join('');
  return `key_${timestamp}_${random}`;
}
```

**Améliorations**:
- ✅ `crypto.getRandomValues()` pour IDs
- ✅ `crypto.getRandomValues()` pour keys (déjà présent)
- ✅ Cryptographically secure RNG
- ✅ Non-predictable key IDs

## Principal Code Reviewer — Major Issues Résolus

### ✅ 1. Memory Leak Fix — `RedisRateLimiter.ts`

**Ajouté**:
- `cleanupInterval` dans `InMemoryRedisClient` (nettoyage toutes les 60s)
- Méthode `cleanup()` pour supprimer les entrées expirées
- Méthode `shutdown()` pour arrêt propre
- `getStoreSize()` pour monitoring

**Résultat**: Fuite mémoire éliminée, nettoyage automatique des clés expirées.

### ✅ 2. Input Validation — `APIKeyManager.ts`

**Ajouté**:
- `validateCreateRequest()` avec 12 validations
- `ValidationError` classe d'erreur dédiée
- Validations sur tous les champs (name, userId, role, permissions, expiresIn, metadata)
- Limites de sécurité (max 50 permissions, 1 an expiration max, 10KB metadata max)

**Résultat**: Toutes les entrées sont validées avant traitement.

### ✅ 3. Circuit Breaker — `VaultClient.ts`

**Ajouté**:
- Classe `CircuitBreaker` (pattern State Machine)
- États: closed → open → half-open
- Threshold: 5 failures
- Timeout: 30s
- Appliqué sur toutes les méthodes Vault (`getSecret`, `writeSecret`, `deleteSecret`, etc.)
- Méthodes de monitoring: `getCircuitBreakerState()`, `getCircuitBreakerFailureCount()`, `resetCircuitBreaker()`

**Résultat**: Protection contre cascading failures si Vault est down.

### ✅ 4. MFA Rate Limiting — `MFAEnforcer.ts`

**Ajouté**:
- `checkRateLimit()` avec tracking des tentatives
- Limite: 10 tentatives par minute par utilisateur
- `MFAAttempt` interface pour tracking
- Erreur avec `retryAfter` calculé
- Nettoyage automatique après expiration de la fenêtre

**Résultat**: Protection contre brute force attacks sur MFA.

### ✅ 5. Token Auto-Refresh — `VaultClient.ts`

**Ajouté**:
- `scheduleTokenRefresh()` appelé après authentification
- Refresh à 80% du lifetime du token
- `tokenRefreshTimer` pour gestion du timer
- Nettoyage dans `revokeToken()` et `updateConfig()`

**Résultat**: Token automatiquement rafraîchi avant expiration.

### ✅ 6. Lint Errors Fix

**Corrigé**:
- `RedisRateLimiter.ts` L336: `let lastTimestamp` → `const lastTimestamp`
- `APIKeyManager.ts`: Ajout de l'interface `CreateAPIKeyRequest` (définie localement)
- `src/security/index.ts`: Export de `ValidationError`

**Résultat**: 0 erreur ESLint/TypeScript.

error : new Error('Unknown error'));\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Verify token and return security context\n   */\n  async verifyAndGetContext(token: string): Promise<SecurityContext | null> {\n    const result = await this.verifyToken(token);\n    \n    if (result.valid && result.securityContext) {\n      return result.securityContext;\n    }\n\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if token is valid\n   */\n  async isTokenValid(token: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const result = await this.verifyToken(token);\n    return result.valid;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get user ID from token\n   */\n  async getUserIdFromToken(token: string): Promise<string | null> {\n    const context = await this.verifyAndGetContext(token);\n    return context?.userId || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get permissions from token\n   */\n  async getPermissionsFromToken(token: string): Promise<string[]> {\n    const context = await this.verifyAndGetContext(token);\n    return context?.permissions || [];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if token has specific permission\n   */\n  async hasPermission(token: string, permission: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const permissions = await this.getPermissionsFromToken(token);\n    return permissions.includes(permission);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update configuration\n   */\n  updateConfig(config: Partial<JWTVerifierConfig>): void {\n    this.verifier.updateConfig(config);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear key cache\n   */\n  clearCache(): void {\n    this.verifier.clearCache();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate input\n   */\n  private validateInput(token: string): void {\n    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {\n      throw new Error('Token is required and must be a string');\n    }\n\n    if (token.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('Token cannot be empty');\n    }\n\n    if (token.length > 10000) {\n      throw new Error('Token is too long');\n    }\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

version: "3.9"

networks:
  osiris-core:
  osiris-data:
  osiris-ai:
  osiris-observability:

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  memgraph_data:
  clickhouse_data:
  opensearch_data:
  qdrant_data:
  redis_data:
  ollama_data:
  prometheus_data:
  grafana_data:
  loki_data:
  tempo_data:

services:

  # =========================================================
  # 🧠 CORE BACKEND
  # =========================================================
  osiris-server:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
      - "9090:9090"
      - "9100:9100"
    environment:
      OSIRIS_CONFIG: /etc/osiris/config.yaml
      OSIRIS_LOG_LEVEL: debug
    volumes:
      - ./config.yaml:/etc/osiris/config.yaml:ro
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      memgraph:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - osiris-core
      - osiris-data

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # =========================================================
  # 🗄️ DATA LAYER
  # =========================================================

  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: osiris
      POSTGRES_USER: osiris
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: osiris_dev
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - osiris-data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U osiris"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  memgraph:
    image: memgraph/memgraph:latest
    ports:
      - "7687:7687"
      - "7444:7444"
    volumes:
      - memgraph_data:/var/lib/memgraph
    networks:
      - osiris-data

  clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:24-alpine
    ports:
      - "8123:8123"
      - "9000:9000"
    volumes:
      - clickhouse_data:/var/lib/clickhouse
    networks:
      - osiris-data

  opensearch:
    image: opensearchproject/opensearch:2.19
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      plugins.security.disabled: "true"
      OPENSEARCH_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    volumes:
      - opensearch_data:/usr/share/opensearch/data
    networks:
      - osiris-data

  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
    volumes:
      - qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage
    networks:
      - osiris-data

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - osiris-data

  # =========================================================
  # 📡 EVENT STREAM (KAFKA FIXÉ)
  # =========================================================

  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.6.0
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - osiris-core

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.6.0
    depends_on:
      - zookeeper
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
    networks:
      - osiris-core

  schema-registry:
    image: confluentinc/cp-schema-registry:7.6.0
    depends_on:
      - kafka
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
    environment:
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY_KAFKASTORE_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY_HOST_NAME: schema-registry
    networks:
      - osiris-core

  # =========================================================
  # 🤖 AI LAYER
  # =========================================================

  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"
    volumes:
      - ollama_data:/root/.ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - osiris-ai

  # =========================================================
  # 📊 OBSERVABILITY
  # =========================================================

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    networks:
      - osiris-observability

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: osiris_admin
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    networks:
      - osiris-observability

  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:latest
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - loki_data:/loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    networks:
      - osiris-observability

  tempo:
    image: grafana/tempo:latest
    ports:
      - "3200:3200"
    volumes:
      - tempo_data:/tmp/tempo
    networks:
      - osiris-observability
